concerns.text: FR-001 (and many other FRs) reference ‘US-1’ (e.g., “See US-1”) but no User Story IDs named US‑1, US‑2, or US‑3 are defined anywhere in the document. All cross‑references must resolve to an existing identifier.

Inconsistent naming of the metric: the specification uses both “HallucinationIndex” (no space) and “Hallucination Index” (with space). Choose a single canonical term and use it consistently throughout FRs, SCs, and the text.
